channel.title: Shipbuilding: Korean small and mid-cap filings
channel.description: New filings from Korean small and mid-cap companies in the shipbuilding sector.

item.title: Medicox: Medicox says Supreme Court finalized convictions of two former inside directors over KRW 11.3bn embezzlement and breach-of-trust case.
Daehan Shipbuilding: Daehan Shipbuilding won a KRW 249.8bn order for two 157,000 DWT crude oil carriers from an Oceania shipowner.
Daehan Shipbuilding: Daehan Shipbuilding reported Q3 2026 consolidated revenue of KRW 327.7bn and operating profit of KRW 82.7bn, up 19.6% and 24.4% year on year.
